title: Gymnastics Skill Hit Rate by Skill Level
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gymnastics:skill
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(result="hit")) as successful by _time skill_level
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for gymnastics skill attempts by skill level.
value: Hit rate by level is a good way to check whether progression is moving faster than consistency.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for gymnastics skill attempts events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for gymnastics skill attempts by skill level.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how often gymnastics skill attempts works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
